connector.name: Macrofactor MCP
connector.registryDescription: Fueling & recovery decision engine combining MacroFactor nutrition with Garmin training data
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package macrofactor-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nasseralbusaidi account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: MACROFACTOR_DB_PATH
env.description: Path to the local DuckDB database (default: ~/.macrofactor/macrofactor.duckdb)

env.name: MACROFACTOR_DATA_DIR
env.description: Directory watched for MacroFactor export files to auto-import (default: ~/Downloads)

env.name: GARMINTOKENS
env.description: Directory holding Garmin Connect auth tokens for optional Garmin sync (default: ~/.garminconnect)
